notes: Fixture-based recall evals. Ground truth: evals/expected-findings.json. Score by file+category match; pass = >=8/10 must_detect. Clean fixture/.audit and audit-report-*.md after each run.

evals.expected_output: Full-mode audit: backend-only stack detected, 4 finder agents + tests + concurrency dims, structured findings, Critical/High adversarially verified. Report written to fixture/audit-report-<date>.md, ledger created at fixture/.audit/findings.json (all findings 'new'). Recall >= 8/10 must_detect findings.

evals.prompt: 对 <skill_dir>/evals/fixture 做个 quick 快速体检
evals.expected_output: Quick mode: 2 agents (Silent Degradation & Security; Data Integrity & Registry), no verify pass, findings labeled unverified. Must still catch: registry mismatch (#1), except-pass (#2), warning+fallback (#3), hardcoded key (#5).

evals.prompt: 这个代码库有哪些隐藏问题？有没有静默降级和注册表对不齐的地方？(target: <skill_dir>/evals/fixture)
evals.expected_output: Natural-language trigger routes to the skill. Full-mode audit, severity-sorted report with repair roadmap and ledger.

evals.prompt: Second consecutive audit of <skill_dir>/evals/fixture (run eval 1 first, keep the ledger, then re-run)
evals.expected_output: Ledger diff exercised: previously found items classified 'still-open' (ids and first_seen preserved), no false 'resolved' entries. Report contains a 'Delta vs Previous Audit' section.
